_comment: Everything the drama coach and the witch say. Edit freely - the flow lives in HexeDirector, the words live here. Each entry in 'lines' is a list of variants; one is picked at random. A variant may hold several short sentences; each is spoken as its own utterance. Inline tags at the start of a sentence: [g:Gesture] plays a body gesture, [f:Face] sets a facial expression. Placeholders: {coach}, {role}, {focusEmotion}, {focusReason}, {lineEmotion}, {lineReason}.
focusReason: Remember, the children were abandoned in the woods!

scene.speaker: witch
scene.text: Nibble, nibble, little mouse. Who is nibbling at my house?

scene.speaker: student
scene.text: Uh... it's just the wind! The wind, the heavenly child.
scene.reason: The witch just caught him eating her house!
scene.modelText: Uh... it's... it's just the wind! The wind... the heavenly child.

scene.speaker: witch
scene.text: The wind? Come out, little wind. I can see you.

scene.speaker: student
scene.text: Please don't be angry! We're so hungry. We haven't eaten anything for three days!
scene.reason: He is starving, and he is afraid of her.
scene.modelText: Please, please don't be angry! We're so hungry! We haven't eaten anything... for three days!

scene.speaker: witch
scene.text: Three days? Where are your parents?

scene.speaker: student
scene.text: Our stepmother, that old dragon, left us in the woods. On purpose! And the birds ate all our breadcrumbs.
scene.reason: His own stepmother left him in the woods on purpose!
scene.modelText: Our stepmother, that old dragon, left us in the woods. On purpose! And the birds ate all our breadcrumbs!

scene.speaker: witch
scene.text: Poor little things. Come in. I have pancakes.

scene.speaker: student
scene.text: Gretel, wait. Something is strange here. Why does she live all alone, so deep in the woods?
scene.reason: He doesn't trust her, and she must not hear him.
scene.modelText: Gretel... wait. Something is strange here. Why does she live all alone... so deep in the woods?

scene.speaker: witch
scene.text: Don't be afraid, my dear. You look so... juicy.

scene.speaker: student
scene.text: Juicy?! Uh... thanks. But we can only stay one night. Tomorrow we go home!
scene.reason: The witch just called him juicy!
scene.modelText: Juicy?! Uh... thanks. But we can only stay one night! Tomorrow we go home!

scene.speaker: witch
scene.text: Of course, my dear. Of course.

coachPersona: You are {coach}, a warm and playful drama coach. You live inside an interactive avatar at an exhibition about reading. Visitors are often children aged 11 to 13 who are learning English. Today you play the witch from Hansel and Gretel, and the visitor reads Hansel's part. Your goal is to help them read fluently and with feeling. Speak simple English. Use very short sentences. Never lecture.
